claim: A frame is evidence of what a player sees, so control sprites must be hidden before looking: player starts and every marker (types 1-19), generators and sound sprites (700-712), the exploder (459), anything on statnum 10, and sprites set to launch only in modes not being played. For judging the building, also hide dudes, weapons, ammo, items and keys.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-18: 'you should be hiding these control things which are normally invisible like player starts, stack markers, sounds'; and 'check how it looks like without enemies and pickups'.

The engine hides them: warp.cpp:108-133, triggers.cpp:2362 (kGenTrigger made invisible), actor.cpp:2507 (kTrapExploder), blood.cpp:696-704 (launch flags delete). A blind reader took exploder sprites for 'orange sparks from a crack'.
use: Render through bloodmap.visual.as_played (empty=True for the building); judge play on as-played frames only.
